n, k = map(int, input().split())

mod = 10**9 + 7

class MatrixData:
    def __init__(self, r=0, c=0):
        self.height = r
        self.width = c
        self.data = [0] * (r * c)

    def element(self, r, c):
        return self.data[r * self.width + c]

    def set_element(self, r, c, value):
        self.data[r * self.width + c] = value

    def add(self, m):
        assert self.height == m.height and self.width == m.width
        for i in range(self.height * self.width):
            self.data[i] += m.data[i]
        return self

    def subtract(self, m):
        assert self.height == m.height and self.width == m.width
        for i in range(self.height * self.width):
            self.data[i] -= m.data[i]
        return self

    def multiply(self, m):
        assert self.width == m.height
        res = MatrixData(self.height, m.width)
        for i in range(self.height):
            for j in range(m.width):
                total = 0
                for k in range(self.width):
                    total += self.element(i, k) * m.element(k, j)
                res.set_element(i, j, total % mod)
        self.data = res.data
        self.height = res.height
        self.width = res.width
        return self

    @staticmethod
    def identity(n):
        res = MatrixData(n, n)
        for i in range(n):
            res.set_element(i, i, 1)
        return res

    @staticmethod
    def power(a, n):
        assert a.height == a.width
        res = MatrixData.identity(a.height)
        base = a
        while n:
            if n & 1:
                res.multiply(base)
            base.multiply(base)
            n >>= 1
        return res

def compute(i, k):
    return MatrixData.power(mats[i + k], k - i).multiply(MatrixData.power(mats[i], i))

def execute(n, k):
    count = 0
    tmp = n
    while tmp:
        tmp //= k
        count += 1
    b = [MatrixData(2 * k + 1) for _ in range(count + 5)]
    c = [MatrixData(2 * k + 1) for _ in range(count + 5)]
    d = [MatrixData(k + 1) for _ in range(k + 1)]
    for i in range(2 * k + 1):
        mats[i] = MatrixData(2 * k + 1)
        for j in range(i):
            mats[i].set_element(0, j, 1)
        for j in range(2 * k - 1):
            mats[i].set_element(j + 1, j, 1)
        mats[i].set_element(2 * k, 0, 1)
        mats[i].set_element(2 * k, 2 * k, 1)

    b[0] = mats[k - 1]
    c[0] = MatrixData.power(b[0], k - 1)
    b[1] = compute(k - 1, k)
    c[1] = MatrixData.power(b[1], k - 1)
    s = MatrixData.identity(2 * k + 1)
    for j in range(2, count + 2):
        b[j] = compute(k - j % k, k)
        s.multiply(c[j - 1])
        b[j].multiply(s)
        c[j] = MatrixData.power(b[j], k - 1)

    idx = 1
    rem = n % k
    n -= rem
    tmp2 = n
    q = 0
    if tmp2:
        while tmp2 % k == 0:
            q += 1
            tmp2 //= k
    q = (k - q % k) % k
    ans = MatrixData.identity(2 * k + 1)
    ans = MatrixData.power(mats[q], rem).multiply(MatrixData.power(mats[q + k], max(rem - q, 0)))
    n //= k
    if n == 0:
        return (ans.element(2 * k, 0) + ans.element(0, 0)) % mod
    n -= 1
    while n:
        t = n % k
        if t:
            ans.multiply(MatrixData.power(b[idx], t))
        n //= k
        idx += 1
    ans.multiply(b[1])
    return (ans.element(2 * k, 0) + ans.element(0, 0)) % mod

print(execute(n, k))
